scope: Synthetic only; no formal real-test scoring performed.
commands: PYTHONPATH=stage2/03_modes_tenv/execution/tests python -c 'from pathlib import Path; from test_pipeline import fixture; fixture(Path("/tmp/tenv-synthetic-input"))'
curve_convention: Nonempty tied-score thresholds only; at grid recall r use precision of first threshold attaining r (right step); no synthetic (0,1) endpoint. Macro-average eligible groups within run before run mean/min/max.
undefined_behavior: No-change PCC/Spearman remain NaN with zero effective groups; AP equals direction prevalence; no arbitrary tie gains. Incomplete entries display run counts and cannot earn complete ranking.
external_adapter_contract: command script .identity.json pins nonempty source_files/environment_files/config_files; request includes command_evidence. checkpoint.json identity matches request, blobs maps every binary checkpoint relative path to SHA256; timings training_seconds/inference_seconds. progress.json marks training/inference.
